environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an AWS ALB with standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirement). The application runs as www-data user with read access to /etc/passwd and other system files. PHP 8.2 with symlink() enabled. The storage/app/reports directory is on the same filesystem as the rest of the system. No AppArmor or SELinux profiles restricting symlink targets. Routes are publicly accessible after standard session authentication.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM certificate, no mutual TLS
config.filesystem: ext4, no mount restrictions, open_basedir not set
config.os_security: No AppArmor/SELinux, www-data has broad read access
config.auth: Standard Laravel session auth, any registered user
